description: Update Quest mnemons. A field left out is left as it is: status, kind, playersCanTick, hook, the giverId / locationId / parentQuestId links (an empty string removes one), and objectives, rewards, background or gmNotes, each of which replaces its part of the quest and keeps the rest. Name existing objectives and chips by the ids get_mnemon's `quest` returns so they keep what the GM wrote under them. To tick one objective, use set_quest_objective_state.

background.description: Replaces the Background section, in Markdown.

entryId.description: Mnemon entry id (hex) or exact title.

giverId.description: Who gives the quest: an NPC's entryId or exact title (its Quest giver link). On update an empty string removes it.

gmNotes.description: Replaces the GM-only notes, in Markdown.

hook.description: The one line players see under the title in the quest log. An empty string clears it.

issuerNpcEntryId.description: Retired quest board field: send giverId.

issuerText.description: Retired quest board field: write it into background.

kind.description: Main | Side | Personal. Reads as Side when unset.

locationId.description: Where the quest is given or set: a Location's entryId or exact title. On update an empty string removes it.

objectives.description: Replaces the objective list. Name an existing objective by id to keep it and what the GM wrote under it; one left out is removed. To tick one objective, use set_quest_objective_state instead.

children.description: Its sub-objectives, in order. Omitted keeps the ones it has; an empty list removes them.

hidden.description: true hides it from players, false shows it; omitted keeps what it has (a new one is shown).

id.description: The objective to rewrite, as get_mnemon's quest.objectives[].id names it. Omit for a new objective.

optional.description: An optional objective does not count toward the quest's progress. Defaults to false.

text.description: The objective, one line of Markdown. Mentions: @[label](mnemon:<entryId>).

hidden.description: true hides it from players, false shows it; omitted keeps what it has (a new one is shown).

id.description: The objective to rewrite, as get_mnemon's quest.objectives[].id names it. Omit for a new objective.

optional.description: An optional objective does not count toward the quest's progress. Defaults to false.

text.description: The objective, one line of Markdown. Mentions: @[label](mnemon:<entryId>).

parentQuestId.description: The quest this one belongs to: a Quest's entryId or exact title. On update an empty string removes it.

playersCanTick.description: Whether players may tick the objectives they can see. Off by default.

relatedLocationEntryIds.description: Locations the quest involves (entryIds or titles).

relatedNpcEntryIds.description: NPCs the quest involves (entryIds or titles).

rewards.description: Replaces the reward chips; an empty list clears them. Name an existing chip by id to keep it.

amount.description: How many: coins, experience points, a stack.

entryId.description: item chips: the mnemon entry it links to (entryId or exact title). Not with ruleEntryId.

hidden.description: true hides the chip from players, false shows it; omitted keeps what it has (a new one is shown).

id.description: The chip to rewrite, as get_mnemon's quest.rewards[].id names it. Omit for a new chip.

itemId.description: Retired reward row: a free-text item reference.

kind.description: currency | xp | item | other. Makes this a reward chip — send it on every reward.

label.description: What the chip says: an item's name, a favour, a title.

linkedStepIds.description: Retired reward row: the stepIds or subquest entry ids that unlock it.

rewardType.description: Retired reward row, without kind: Gold | Item | XP | Reputation …

ruleEntryId.description: item chips: the rules-library entry it links to. Not with entryId.

unit.description: currency chips: the coin, as the campaign's setting names it (e.g. coin.gp), or free text such as 'gold'.

unitLabel.description: How the coin reads, e.g. 'Gold piece'.

status.description: Available | Active | Completed | Failed. Reads as Available when unset.

steps.description: Retired: the old quest board's steps, for quests the migration has not converted. Send objectives.

notes.description: Free-text bullet notes for the step.

status.description: Defaults to 'Available' when omitted. Unknown values are coerced server-side.

stepId.description: Optional. Server generates a fresh UUID when blank. Provide an existing stepId to reuse linkedStepIds.

targetNpcEntryIds.description: NPCs involved in this step (entryIds or titles).

title.description: Short label for the step, e.g. 'Talk to the innkeeper'.

subQuestEntryIds.description: This quest's subquests (entryIds or titles). Prefer parentQuestId on each subquest.

name: update_quest_mnemons
title: Update quest mnemons
